Class PanelDispatch

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.PanelDispatch
public final class PanelDispatch extends Object
Phase 16j R2 — shared element-iteration primitive across the four rendering contexts (MK standalone screens, MKC container screens, HUD overlays, vanilla-screen injection adapters). The per-element render contract is PanelElement.render(RenderContext) and was always uniform; this primitive makes the surrounding iteration uniform too.

Why a separate utility

Each context wraps the iteration with context-specific positioning, backgrounds, and bookkeeping (HUD: visibility gates + region resolution; standalone: layout-relative content origin; container: post-recenter leftPos/topPos; injection: origin-fn-resolved screen origin). The wrapping legitimately varies — but the per-frame "build ctx, iterate elements, skip-if-hidden, render" inner loop is identical in all four. Pre-16j it was duplicated four times; bug fixes to the iteration shape (e.g., element-visibility semantics, future per-element pre/post hooks) had to be applied four ways.

Per §0027: the rendering contract is uniform. R2 makes the iteration uniform as well.

  • Method Details

    • renderElements

      public static void renderElements(Panel panel, RenderContext ctx)
      Iterates panel's elements in declaration order, skipping any whose PanelElement.isVisible() returns false, and dispatches each visible element's render(ctx).

      Doesn't draw the panel background — that's a per-context concern (HUD optionally uses panel.getStyle(); standalone always does; MKC does as part of renderBg; injection adapter has its own variant). Callers are expected to draw the background before calling this dispatch so elements layer on top.

      Parameters:
      panel - the panel whose elements to render
      ctx - the render context, already positioned at the content origin (panel origin + padding) by the caller

    • renderElements

      public static void renderElements(List<PanelElement> elements, RenderContext ctx)
      Iterates elements in declaration order, skipping any whose PanelElement.isVisible() returns false, and dispatches each visible element's render(ctx). Used by the HUD render path, which holds elements on MKHudPanelDef (a record) rather than Panel.
